description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Report on Review of the Balance Sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as at 28th February 2021
categorisation: This gazette content consists of the balance sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, which is a financial institution. The document contains detailed financial data including assets, liabilities, foreign currency holdings, securities, and other banking-related financial information. This falls under commercial matters specifically related to banking and financial institution reporting, making it a Type 6 (Commercial) classification.
